    for e in output_dict.get("entities", []):
        entities.add((e["text"], e["type"], e["start"], e["end"]))

def entity_f1_counts(pred, gold):
    tp = len(pred & gold)

    fn = len(gold - pred)
    return tp, fp, fn


def instance_f1(pred, gold):

    if tp == 0:

    r = tp / (tp + fn)

def micro_f1(tp, fp, fn):
    if tp == 0:
        return 0.0
    p = tp / (tp + fp)
    r = tp / (tp + fn)
    return 2 * p * r / (p + r)


def process_file(path):
